settings.title: Are your soaps handmade?
settings.answer: Yes. Royal Being bars are handcrafted in small batches in the USA.

settings.title: Where do you ship?
settings.answer: Eligible markets at launch: USA, Netherlands, and Belgium. Worldwide shipping remains aspirational until Markets rates are approved.

settings.title: Do you offer subscriptions?
settings.answer: Monthly subscriptions are supported via Shopify Subscriptions or a compatible app once selling plans are configured per product.

settings.title: What is ROYAL 20?
settings.answer: A 20% coupon requested by the brand. Activation rules (dates, stacking, exclusions) require owner approval before enabling in Shopify Admin.

settings.title: Can I customize a soap?
settings.answer: Yes — use the Customize Your Soap page for inquiry until options, pricing, and fulfillment rules are confirmed.

settings.title: What about sold-out or coming-soon bars?
settings.answer: Join the waitlist on the product page. Coming-soon / test-mode products never appear as normal in-stock items.

settings.title: How should I store my bar?
settings.answer: Keep the bar dry between uses on a draining dish, away from standing water, to help it last and last.

settings.title: Are your products cruelty-free?
settings.answer: Yes. Royal Being is cruelty-free and biodegradable, formulated without parabens, synthetic sulfates, or phthalates.
